# Settings and setup

::: {.doc-lead}
Open the gear in the titlebar to adjust the workspace. Use Set up Flux for tools that need installation.
:::

## General {#general}

**Set up Flux…** checks the terminal launcher, Python plotting, Word export through Quarto, PDF through Quarto, and AI integrations. See [Installation](/install/) for requirements and commands.

**FluxConfig folder** shows where your shared library and context live. Use **Reveal** to open it or **Move…** to relocate it through Flux. Projects remain separate folders. See [Library and configuration](/docs/configuration.html).

**Agents** controls access to the current Flux window and the agent runners used by Ask. Window access applies to that project's Flux window. [Connect an agent](/docs/connect.html) describes setup; [Comments and Inbox](/docs/comments.html) describes Ask, watching and live pairing.

**Updates** controls checking for a newer desktop version on launch. **Palette** controls whether new projects include the Flexoki palette.

## Figure {#figure}

| Setting | Effect |
|---|---|
| Rulers | Show rulers; drag from a ruler to place a guide. Shortcut: **Shift+R**. |
| Background grid | Show the grid. While visible, pen nodes use its vertices. Shortcut: **Shift+G**. |
| Snap to grid / grid size | Set alignment to a regular interval. |
| Snap to pixel | Round coordinates when an edit is committed. |
| Figure-Meta font size | Change the caption editor's typing size, from 9 to 28 px. |
| Plot gallery search scope | Choose whether search reaches project plots, global plots, or both. |
| Folder click behavior | Choose whether a gallery folder click also expands its subtree. |
| Palette and colormap collection | Choose which collection a colour picker opens first. |

Inside a colour picker, **Tab** changes between palettes and colormaps; **Shift+Tab** cycles collections. Press **F** with objects selected to open the property menu. See [Layout and drawing](/docs/figure-layout.html) and [Plot editing](/docs/plot-editing.html).

## Paper {#paper}

Choose the dynamic margin's background, set the maximum number of open panes (1–6), and enable **Clean dynamic margin** to close panes when focus returns to the editor.

Caret motion has its own feel setting. **Chase** settles toward the target; **Smooth** uses a short, constant-pace glide. Document text size is adjusted in Paper and is independent of export typography. See [Writing tools](/docs/writing-tools.html).

## Corrections {#corrections}

Configure local spelling and punctuation corrections, dictionaries and aliases. Optional sentence judgment has a separate provider choice and setup. The local managed model and cloud provider are explicit choices; see [Writing tools](/docs/writing-tools.html#local-corrections) for behavior, downloads and data handling.

## Where to find other preferences {#other-preferences}

Some controls belong beside the work: slide themes and animation styles live in [Slides](/docs/slides.html); library services and Zotero settings live in [Library](/docs/library.html); export styles are chosen when [exporting a document](/docs/export-documents.html).
